content: Tauri desktop/tray app pitfalls include: Windows tray left-click events not firing, Linux webkit2gtk version incompatibilities, macOS dock icon requiring ActivationPolicy::Accessory to hide, Tauri v1-to-v2 system tray API breaking changes, and the need to pin dependency versions. Tray icons behave differently across platforms (Windows 16x16, macOS 22x22@2x). Dynamic menu updates require careful async handling.
